values: 一名尊贵神勇的战士，会在战斗中逐渐发挥超越他人的实力。
A noble, fearless Warrior who grows stronger as the battle goes on.
Is all well, then? That's most reassuring.
Since you asked... Watch and behold my glory.
剑确实有点重……没人看见吧？
The sword is heavier than I remembered... No one heard that, yes?
太棒了，绝妙的礼物，感谢你，亲爱的朋友
A precious offering. I am grateful, my friend.
友谊的见证！谢谢你，朋友
A gesture of friendship. My thanks.
肮脏的堕落之物！抱歉，我无法接受。
What a vile offering! This is beneath me.
How does one find a new hobby...?
Now this is a cozy place.
巴赫朗喜爱人类，无需上战场时，他经常会以富商或者慈善家的身份与人们打交道——久而久之，比起半神的尊号，反而用于伪装的身份更出名了。

Baelran has a deep fondness for humans. In peaceful times, he often walks among them as a wealthy merchant or philanthropist. Over time, these personas have begun to eclipse his true identity—a Celestial.
即使在城镇中隐居，巴赫朗也习惯雇佣至少一百人的仆从团队照顾他的日常生活。
Even as a recluse, Baelran still employs at least a hundred servants to take care of his daily needs.
在诸多半神中，巴赫朗也是最为习惯于奢侈生活的那一档。他与萨基塔里斯的区别是，萨基塔里斯将奢华的生活作为艺术享受，而巴赫朗只是习以为常。
Among the Celestials, Baelran is one of those who embrace extravagance as a way of life. Unlike Dionel, who treats luxury as a form of artistic indulgence, Baelran regards it as his routine.
巴赫朗个性亲切友善，做事勤恳可靠，大约正因如此，他反而是半神之中人缘最好的那一位。
Baelran is friendly by nature and dependable in his work, making him the most well-liked among his kind.
巴赫朗的绅士风度和彬彬有礼在面对伊莱亚与莱拉的时候，完全没有用武之地，这也让他难得地会感到头痛。
Much to Baelran's dismay, his courteous manners hold no sway when dealing with Elijah and Lailah.
萨基塔里斯和巴赫朗有着相当不错的私交，但这并不影响他评价巴赫朗为“冷淡而缺乏乐趣”；同样，巴赫朗也评价他“过于情绪化，容易冲动”。
Dionel and Baelran are close friends, yet they don't hesitate to point out each other's flaws. While Dionel sees Baelran as aloof and boring, Baelran finds Dionel overly emotional and impulsive.
巴赫朗很擅长交友和送礼，他甚至只用几盒特制的齿轮，就叩开了斯克嘉莉德的心扉——物理的，她当场迫不及待地替换掉了胸腔里的旧零件。

Baelran's charm knows no bounds—just ask Scarlita. After he gifted her a few boxes of custom-made gear, she quite literally opened her heart to him... by replacing the parts in her chest right then and there.
巴赫朗在神魔大战期间以强大的实力而闻名于世，以至于民间都有许多人将他作为护佑军势，带来胜利的武神所信奉；但很奇怪的是，不知道为什么，近年来，越来越多人开始认为他会带来财富了……
Baelran gained fame for his immense power during the Divine War, revered by the people as the god of war. But things took a strange turn as more began to associate him with prosperity...
巴赫朗的绅士风度曾经让许多人为之称道，大概正因如此，他很不擅长应对胡搅蛮缠的失礼之人。
Baelran's gentlemanly demeanor is well respected, but it often leaves him at a loss when dealing with unruly troublemakers.
曾经有许多人评价过巴赫朗“本质上是个无情的人”。
Many believe that beneath Baelran's affable exterior lies a cold-hearted man.
难得遇到你啊，朋友，我还以为你这会儿又在开宴会呢。
It's a rare opportunity to see you here, my friend. I thought you were busy hosting another party.
巴赫朗 & 萨基塔里斯
我看到你这次对深岩村进行的投资方案了，你看好那边的发展？
I see that you've been investing in Brimstone Village. You must be optimistic about the development over there.
How does one find a new hobby...?
